objective: Use cases and telemetry authored by organizations outside this project to audit workload coverage and physical-data compatibility without retraining, threshold tuning, artifact promotion, or physical actuation.

sources.evidence_class: externally designed and physically recorded robot/test-stand telemetry
sources.selection_rule: Select all three SO-101 files whose publisher-assigned names begin heldout, plus H1 test-stand trials spanning nominal low frequency, reduced high frequency, and xlarge chirp. Selection uses only repository metadata and filenames, not signal values or model outputs.

sources.license: repository terms at the frozen revision
sources.evidence_class: externally authored cloud/OS benchmark taxonomy and measured performance traces
case_families: Flexible IO random read and write
sources.use: Define the natural-use and contention workload mix. Azure measurements are not projected into FerrumOS state vectors and are not presented as FerrumOS labels.

physical_compatibility_checks: download every frozen Anchor-Lab file from the frozen revision
record SHA-256, row count, field names, timestamp count, median sampling interval, p99 sampling interval, and non-finite count
require measured state plus actuator or command fields before any dynamics-replay classification
classify compatibility separately for timing, state observation, command observation, safety labels, contact labels, and direct Physical JEPA v5 semantics
gates: all selected external files are available and digest-recorded
no source field is silently reinterpreted as a FerrumOS or Physical JEPA label
no frozen model, threshold, deployed disk, or deployed artifact is modified
actuator attempts and deliveries remain zero
claim_boundary: Externally authored cases remove local case-design dependence, but this researcher-executed audit is not independent assessment. Physical telemetry may establish data suitability and actuator-disabled replay feasibility; it cannot establish live Ferrum HIL, collision avoidance, contact recovery, or deployment safety.
